research_question: Did the gap in within-cohort math achievement percentile rank between lowest-band and highest-band SES students change between the ELS:2002 and HSLS:09 high school cohorts (gap-in-gaps difference-in-differences)?

outcome.definition: within-cohort percentile rank (0-100) of the base-wave standardized math score

rationale_for_method_set: M8 is the certified gap-in-gaps estimator with stratified bootstrap; no regression DiD comparator in the first live run to keep the contract surface minimal.
known_concerns_to_flag: CCD-01 non-equated tests: only rank-gap changes are estimable
CCD-02 bundled treatment: the 2002-2009 cohort contrast bundles many changes; no single-policy attribution
grade offset: ELS base wave is grade 10, HSLS base wave is grade 9
